files.title: Students and parents
files.purpose: Admissions, student profiles and family contacts.
notes: Enter a student once. Capture enrollment details in the separate Enrollments file.
Enter each parent or guardian once, including parents of siblings. Use Relationships to link the same parent to multiple students.

fields.label: Student code
fields.description: Permanent unique student code, reused in all other files.

fields.label: Admission number
fields.description: Official college admission number; preserve leading zeros.

sheets.name: Parents
sheets.row_rule: One row per distinct parent or guardian.

fields.label: Parent or guardian code
fields.description: Permanent unique parent code; reuse for siblings.

files.title: Courses and subjects
files.purpose: Available courses, curriculum structure and subject requirements.
notes: Use course codes consistently in enrollment, fee and timetable records. A course means a degree or program, not an individual subject.
Course Subjects links reusable subjects to a course, curriculum version, semester and elective group.

sheets.name: Courses
sheets.row_rule: One row per available course or program.

fields.label: Course code
fields.description: Permanent unique course or program code.

response.schema_projection_status: Expanded collection specification. Target names are planning hints, not implemented SQL column mappings.
validation_rules: Import by filename and data-tab name. Match exact row-6 visible headers, including required-field asterisks, to field keys. Ignore rows 1-5 and the Guide tab.
Skip fully blank input rows, including rows containing only calculated formulas. Ignore calculated columns and recompute their results on the server. Reject formulas in user input columns.

response.note: Cash receipts only. Expense payment-mode capture is required for the full cash book.
